# Harsh Nigam

> Marketing Strategist at IInfotanks (Bengaluru, India). Leads a 21-person team running SEO, AI search (AEO/GEO), Google and Meta Ads, social media and content for 10+ clients in India and the US.

## Focus
- SEO and AI search visibility: on-page, off-page, technical SEO, schema (JSON-LD), entity optimization, llms.txt, AI citation tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Copilot
- Paid media: Google Ads and Meta Ads, averaging 2.5:1 ROAS
- Content and social: content strategy, editorial calendars, LinkedIn thought leadership, email

## Clients (full marketing)
